description: This file defines the ZooKeeperClusteringProviderBuilder class, which implements provider configuration for Orleans clustering using ZooKeeper, supporting both silo and client builders.

classes.name: ZooKeeperClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class that implements provider builder interfaces for configuring ZooKeeper clustering in Orleans for both silos and clients.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use ZooKeeper clustering with settings from the provided configuration section.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder)
methods.description: Configures the client builder to use ZooKeeper clustering with settings from the provided configuration section.
